Why do you make a separate commit to "Fix build failures"? This kind of fixes belongs in the first commit, because such fixes may make it harder to use `git bisect` later.
I choose `squash and merge` the changes checkbox in the merge request. So i thought that will squash. Unfortunately it didn't. I will make sure i will amend the commit next time.
